title: Cold Care Essentials: DIY Remedies for Comfort & Relief
seo_title: Cold Care Essentials: DIY Natural Remedies Class
description: This is a hands-on class led by MaryBeth Hood of Canyon Edge Farms, where you make natural remedies for the colder months. You make four products to take home: a soothing foot soak, a respiratory roller bottle, a natural herbal vapor balm, and a natural hand sanitizer. MaryBeth shares simple techniques so you can keep making these cold-care essentials at home.
